protocol.setup: Payload creation + one full FNV-1a correctness hash outside throughput timing
protocol.run: Fixed operation loop; per-result O(1) fingerprint consumed into checksum; host timing only
protocol.checksumTransport: s32 preserves all32 checksum bits; host reinterprets as unsigned. Native scalar-export, imported-I32 and signed-BigInt corrections are separately validated; this workload keeps its historical checksum ABI.
protocol.byteDefinition: Input payload bytes; hex string is twice that many ASCII code units
protocol.allocationPolicy: Same current-source release engine; profile installed in BOTH arms; JS arm additionally bundles actual Jco adapter
protocol.scope: ASCII UTF-8 and valid lowercase hex; bounded supported domain. No claimed full Buffer or whole-application speedup

lock.repair: Only replace the inconsistent js-component-bindgen 2.10.1 local lock entry with the declared published 2.11.0 registry package and its checksum; all other lock entries are unchanged.

componentizerProvenance.scope: Guest packaging only; native guest engine and host executable selected separately

armOrder: native first for even scenario indexes; javascript first for odd

limitations: Microbenchmarks in one local machine run; not whole-application performance claims
Seven batches within an instance are correlated; the default has three fresh instances, not 21 fully independent trials
Both arms use the same profile-enabled engine, so the size delta is incremental JS adapter overhead, not minimal profile-off deployment savings
No guest clock/capability imports. Host Instant times batches of operations plus an O(1) result fingerprint, not an isolated CPU primitive
The fingerprint reads a constant number of result positions; sampled character access may materialize a JavaScript rope string, so string throughput includes that observable work
Setup includes input preparation and one full FNV correctness hash; first batch and warmed throughput are separate
Fresh component instances share a deserialized component within one process; compiler is isolated in a separate compile process
RSS includes Wasmtime code, runtime and allocator retention; later instance peaks are cumulative within each measurement process
Largest linear-memory request is a ResourceLimiter observation, not total guest heap or aggregate resident memory
Checksum transport retains historical s32 reinterpreted as u32; current native/package ABI corrections have separate differential gates
